correctness.rationale: Independently implemented F25 ring arithmetic and nonzero squares: 25 vertices, 12 neighbors per vertex; enumerated 515 clique faces with counts (25,150,250,75,15). Independently generated two distinct deterministic ordered-vertex Morse matchings (numeric and x-first), each leaves one critical vertex and 64 critical 2-cells, and checked global Hasse acyclicity on all 1,425 incidences; yields integral ∨64 S². Independently computed mod2 boundary ranks (24,126,60,15). For each of 25 translations counted signed invariant simplices and recovered traces (64,4×12,−1×12); Fourier character equations give multiplicities 3 on square line directions, 2 on nonsquare, four trivial. Two independent square-direction translations fix barycenters of translated 5-cliques, generate T; by Armstrong fundamental group of quotient is trivial; finite-group averaging gives rational invariant H2=Q4. No claimed integral quotient-homology splitting.

value.rationale: The 25-vertex Paley graph is a canonical finite-field strongly regular/Latin-square graph. Integral homotopy is stronger than previously tabulated homology, and the exact additive character plus nonfree quotient π1/H2 are structurally motivated equivariant invariants. The result provides a reproducible model for symmetry of flag complexes, not only a single Betti number.
